verdict.rationale: Shortwave documents migration guides from Gmail, Spark and Superhuman, and has an 'import full history' how-to. It imports the last 90 days by default. Community reports say the free plan does not import pre-signup history beyond 90 days, and that settings such as aliases and signatures carry over. Several users note it only works with Gmail, so it imports history from a Gmail account rather than from arbitrary providers. Missing for 10: contact import, import from non-Gmail or IMAP providers, clear documentation of full-history import beyond 90 days and its plan requirements, and independent confirmation that complete history imports successfully.
